tags.name: ReadFS
tags.description:
ReadFS exposes the read-only surface of a [ufs.ReadFS] file system over
RPC: metadata lookup, directory listing, symbolic link resolution, and
streaming file content.

ufs.ReadFS's io.Closer.Close is intentionally not exposed here: it tears
down the entire underlying file system (e.g. unmounting or disconnecting
a cloud storage client) rather than acting on a single request, and is a
server-lifecycle concern rather than a per-client one.

Errors follow standard gRPC canonical codes: a lookup for a path that does
not exist returns NOT_FOUND (wrapping fs.ErrNotExist), and an operation
forbidden by the backend returns PERMISSION_DENIED (wrapping
fs.ErrPermission).

get.summary:
GetFileSystemInfo describes the file system itself. Equivalent to
[ufs.ReadFS.URI] and [ufs.ReadFS.String].

ListFiles returns the immediate children of a directory. Equivalent to
[ufs.ReadFS.ReadDir].

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description:
The directory whose immediate children should be listed. "." lists the
root directory.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description:
The maximum number of files to return. The service may return fewer
than this value. If unspecified, the server picks a reasonable default.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description:
A page token received from a previous ListFiles call, used to retrieve
the next page.

get.summary:
GetFile returns metadata for the file at name. Equivalent to
[ufs.ReadFS.Stat], or [ufs.ReadFS.Lstat] when symlink_handling is
SYMLINK_HANDLING_NO_FOLLOW.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The path of the file to retrieve.

parameters.name: symlinkHandling
parameters.description:
Whether to follow a trailing symbolic link at name. Defaults to
SYMLINK_HANDLING_FOLLOW.

 - SYMLINK_HANDLING_UNSPECIFIED: Equivalent to SYMLINK_HANDLING_FOLLOW.
 - SYMLINK_HANDLING_FOLLOW: Follow the symbolic link and describe its target. Equivalent to
[ufs.ReadFS.Stat] / [fs.Stat].
 - SYMLINK_HANDLING_NO_FOLLOW: Do not follow the symbolic link; describe the link itself. Equivalent to
[fs.ReadLinkFS.Lstat].

get.summary:
ReadFile streams the content of the file at name. Equivalent to opening
the file via [ufs.ReadFS.Open] and reading its contents, or
[ufs.ReadFS.ReadFile] when the client buffers the full stream.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The path of the file to read.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description:
The byte offset to start reading from. 0 reads from the start of the
file.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
The maximum number of bytes to return across the whole stream. 0 (the
default) reads to the end of the file.

get.summary:
ReadLink returns the destination of the symbolic link at name.
Equivalent to [ufs.ReadFS.ReadLink].

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The path of the symbolic link to resolve.

name.description: The path of the file, relative to the root of the file system.

size.description: Length in bytes for regular files; system-dependent for others.

mode.description: File mode bits, as defined by Go's io/fs.FileMode.

modTime.description: The time the file was last modified.

isDir.description: Whether the file is a directory. Equivalent to mode's directory bit.

ufsFile.description:
File is the resource representation of a node (regular file or directory)
in a [ufs.ReadFS] tree. It mirrors [ufs.FileInfo].

File names follow [fs.ValidPath]: forward-slash separated, no leading
slash, no "." or ".." components. The root directory is always ".".

uri.description:
The URI that identifies this file system, as returned by [ufs.ReadFS.URI].
Can be passed to ufs.New to reconstruct an equivalent file system.
Empty if the file system has no meaningful URI.

description.description:
A human-readable description of how the file system is composed, as
returned by [ufs.ReadFS.String]. Intended for debugging and logging, not
programmatic use.

ufsFileSystemInfo.description:
FileSystemInfo describes the file system as a whole. It is a singleton
resource (AIP-156): there is exactly one, and it has no name field.

files.description:
The immediate children of the requested parent directory, sorted by
filename, as returned by [ufs.ReadFS.ReadDir].

nextPageToken.description:
A token that can be sent as page_token to retrieve the next page. Empty
if there are no more files.

data.description:
A chunk of file content. Chunks are delivered in order starting at
offset and are concatenated by the client to reconstruct the requested
range.

target.description:
The destination path of the symbolic link, as returned by
[ufs.ReadFS.ReadLink]. May be relative to the link's directory.

ufsSymlinkHandling.description:
SymlinkHandling controls whether a lookup follows a symbolic link to its
target or reports on the link itself.

 - SYMLINK_HANDLING_UNSPECIFIED: Equivalent to SYMLINK_HANDLING_FOLLOW.
 - SYMLINK_HANDLING_FOLLOW: Follow the symbolic link and describe its target. Equivalent to
[ufs.ReadFS.Stat] / [fs.Stat].
 - SYMLINK_HANDLING_NO_FOLLOW: Do not follow the symbolic link; describe the link itself. Equivalent to
[fs.ReadLinkFS.Lstat].
